description.description: One line on what it does.

x-enum-labels.shared: One lease serves every user whose route and settings are equal, and ends after the last one.
x-enum-labels.per_session: Each session has a lease of its own, which ends with the session.

sharing.description: Whether the host may share a lease between users.

secrets.description: The settings whose value is the name of a host variable (a password's), by key. The host reads those variables and hands the values over in [`OpenRequest::variables`]; a page asks for the name.

scope.description: Who the lease is for: `host`, `account:NAME` or `session:ID`.

reaches.description: The addresses the user will reach, for a route that chooses per destination (a PAC script) or must know where it is going.

variables.description: The values of the variables [`RouteInfo::secrets`] names that are set. A variable that is not set is absent, which [`NetworkRoute::check`] reports.

private_dir.description: A folder private to the lease, given only when [`RouteLease::trust`] asks the host to write files.

base_dir.description: The folder a relative path in the settings is made from (the folder of canoa.cfg), when the configuration has one.

problems.description: What is wrong, each in words that name the setting and never a value; empty when the route can be opened.

x-enum-labels.system: What the system says: the proxy variables of the environment, else the operating system's settings, PAC and WPAD included.
x-enum-labels.proxy: Through the proxy of `http_proxy`, `https_proxy` or `all_proxy` that fits the destination's scheme (an HTTP proxy, or `socks5://`; it must carry CONNECT, since TLS and WebSocket tunnels use it).
x-enum-labels.pac: A PAC script chooses: `pac` is a URL, a `file:` URL, a path or the script's text.

all_proxy.description: The proxy of every other address, for [`Via::Proxy`].

user.description: A login for every HTTP proxy that names none of its own.

no_proxy.description: The hosts that go direct, in `NO_PROXY` form, replacing the system's list; absent keeps it.

negotiate.description: Whether a proxy that asks for Negotiate or NTLM is answered with the logon session; absent is the host's default.

client_certificate.description: Which client certificate is sent: `system`, `none` or the path of a PEM file holding a chain and its key.

ca_file.description: Trust exactly the certificates of this PEM file, replacing the system's trust.

git_tls.description: Whose TLS library git uses: `system` or `git`.

secret.description: Whether the value is secret: a report names the variable and never shows it.

roots_pem.description: The certificates, as PEM. The host writes them into the session's private folder and names them by the `SSL_CERT_FILE` family of variables.

description.description: What it does now, in a line.

address.description: The address it listens on, when it runs a proxy of its own.

detail.description: More, for a person who asks.
